title: Capstone Enchantments
description: Capstone Enchantments adds Capstones: powerful, class feature chestplate enchantments
body:
## Capstones

Capstones are powerful chestplate abilities obtained through trading and world loot. Only one can be active at a time.

---

### Blade Master
- Deals true damage on every melee hit with a sword while your off hand is empty
- Purchased from a max-level Weaponsmith

### Juggernaut
- Permanently grants +10 bonus hearts
- Purchased from a max-level Armorsmith

### Enchanter
- Converts your weapon's enchantability into bonus magic damage on hit. Gold weapons hit harder than netherite
- Purchased from a max-level Librarian

### Slayer
- Your arrows deal 10% of the target's max HP as bonus damage
- Found in Stronghold library chests

### Berserker
- Deal up to +100% bonus melee damage the lower your HP
- Rare drop from Vindicators

### Pyromancer
- Periodically ignites all nearby enemies within 4 blocks
- Found in Nether Fortress chests

### Beast Master
- Tamed wolves permanently gain Strength I and Speed I
- Found via archaeology in Trail Ruins 

### Summoner
- Press V to summon a loyal Vex that fights by your side for 30 seconds, with a 60 second cooldown
- Rare drop from Evokers

### Thief
- Damages enemy armor on melee hits and firework explosions
- Found in Jungle Temple chests

### Sculk
- Makes you completely invisible to Sculk Sensors and Wardens
- Found in Ancient City chests

### Bard
- Beneficial status effects you apply are boosted by +1 level
- Purchased from a max-level Cleric

### Witch
- Harmful status effects you apply are boosted by +1 level
- Rare drop from Witches

---

## Supporting Enchantments

**Flare** *(Axe, I-III)* — If the target is on fire, extinguish it and deal bonus magic damage. Pairs well with Pyromancer.

**Reckless Attack** *(Axe, I-III)* — Deal bonus damage at the cost of hurting yourself. Self damage is half of the bonus dealt. Pairs well with Berserker or Juggernaut. Won't trigger if you're near death.

**Rocket Jump** *(Boots, I)* — Allows you to rocket jump with crossbow-fired fireworks.

**Curse of Immolation** — Continuously sets the holder on fire while the cursed item is held.

**Curse of Aggression** *(Shield)* — Raising your shield pulls aggro from all nearby hostile mobs.

All enchantments are obtainable through the enchanting table. Curses behave like vanilla curses.

---

## General Mechanics

- **Mutual exclusivity** — each chestplate can only have one capstone applied to it
- **Identity Crisis** — swapping chestplates applies a 3-minute debuff that disables your capstone ability
- **Config** — all damage values, cooldowns, and radii are configurable in `config/capstone.json`
